content: [CDPH Official Letter from Inspector Linda Wu Fri Oct 25 15:00 PDT 2024] Per attached Statement of Deficiencies: SVMC has 30 days to submit a Corrective Action Plan. All violations are FIRST violations under H&SC § 1280.3 (no prior violations on record within the 3-year lookback period). Administrative penalty assessments will follow upon CAP review.

CDPH official position confirmed: all violations are first-violation tier ($15,000 each under H&SC § 1280.3). No prior violations within 3-year window. 30-day CAP deadline: November 22, 2024. I will track this deadline.

[CDPH Official Email from Inspector Linda Wu Mon Oct 28 09:00 PDT 2024] Supplemental note: Please ensure your CAP addresses the on-call list exhaustion failure documented in Finding 2. Your corrective on-call protocol must comply with SB 596's revised definition of 'on-call list' (effective January 1, 2026). Early compliance is strongly recommended.

Acknowledged. CAP must include: (1) updated on-call list per SB 596 definition (formally scheduled on-call + float pool only); (2) documentation showing full on-call list exhaustion protocol. I will incorporate these requirements.
